_about: What each real JEE Advanced physical question (2019-2025, data/jee_advanced) asks, labelled by hand on 2026-11-25. Yardstick only: nothing from it goes into generation (novelty rule). 77 unique questions (includes 4 bonding/intermolecular-force questions the data files under Physical); 2025P2 Q8-Q11 repeat 2025P1 Q8-Q11 and are not counted again (their two full-marks % are averaged). Kinds: P1 direct calculation with standard formulas, data given plainly; P2 short calculation with one hidden trap or deduction (a usual shortcut gives the wrong answer: water's own H+, n-factor per mole asked, moles of gas formed, a second equilibrium, adding E values instead of free energies); P3 read a graph, figure or data table, then derive; P4 conceptual statements (mostly multiple correct, little or no calculation); P5 two chapters linked in one calculation; P6 descriptive facts (surface chemistry, colloids). Caution: P2 was labelled while the 2022-2025 student % were visible, so that label may be biased; 2019-2021 (no data) has 6 P2 of 39. Texts cut in the data (2020P2_Q15, 2021P1_Q9/Q10, 2021P2_Q3, 2022P1_Q15, 2022P2_Q9/Q10, 2023P2_Q14/Q15) were labelled from the sub-topic.
